name: mail
description: Send transactional and broadcast email through the nSelf stack: mux + Postmark pipeline via ping_api, template management, and DKIM verification.
author: nself

actions.broadcast: Send a broadcast to a list using a saved template
actions.status: Query delivery status for a sent message

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables of its own — it calls ping_api (default https://ping.nself.org), which proxies to the mux + transactional-email (Postmark) pro plugins. `nself plugin install mail` must place the built nself-mail binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-mail, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself mail <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/mail.go, mail_transactional.go, and mail_admin.go under CLI-R11. Requires an nSelf+ or nClaw bundle license (matching the underlying transactional-email plugin's requires_license: true); exits 2 with a clear message when no license key is configured, exactly as the in-core command did.
